```{r}
#| echo: false
#| include: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)

######## Load the spending data
spending_url <- "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Reading4All/NY/refs/heads/main/data/SPENDING%2CENROLLMENT/ST3-SPED-2025.csv"
spending_raw <- read_csv(spending_url, show_col_types = FALSE)

# Extract Account Code and Title rows for spec_all
acct_row  <- spending_raw %>% filter(BEDSCODE == "Account Code")
title_row <- spending_raw %>% filter(BEDSCODE == "Title")

######## Master Metadata Table (spec_all)
# Create a single reference table for all columns in spending_raw
spec_all <- tibble(
  col   = names(spending_raw),
  code  = as.character(unlist(acct_row[1, ],  use.names = FALSE)),
  title = as.character(unlist(title_row[1, ], use.names = FALSE))
)

######## Common Suffix & Group Ordering
item_order  <- c("2", "45", "48", "4", "471", "472", "473", "49")
group_order <- c("School Age", "Early Intervention", "Summer", "Preschool")


######## For reference, what's in the CSV
## General Fund
## A2250_ = SPED Spending
## A1420_ = Legal Spending
## A2820_ = Pycological Services
## A2825_ = Social Work Services
## A2830_ = Special Schools

# Special Aid Fund
## F2250_ = SPED Spending - School Age
## F2251_ = SPED Spending - Early Intervention
## F2252_ = SPED Spending - Pre-School
## F2253_ = SPED Spending - Summer
## F5511_ = SPED Transportation - District
## F5541_ = SPED Transportation - Summer, Contract
## F5551_  = SPED Transportation - Summer, Public 
## F5582_ = SPED Transportation - Summer, to BOCES
## F5598_ = SPED Transportation - Summer Total

## A9901_95 = Transfer from Gen Fund to Special Fund -- good to have
## fyi, on ST3, Account codes without "_" is revenue, not spending

######## Special Aid Funds Metadata (sf_meta)
sf_meta <- spec_all %>%
  filter(
    str_starts(code, "F"),             # Keep FXXXX account codes
    str_detect(code, "_"),             # Exclude revenue lines (no _)
    !str_detect(code, "_0"),           # Exclude totals (_0)
    !str_starts(code, "F55"),          # Exclude Transportation (F55)
    !str_detect(code, "_(15|16|8)$")   # Exclude Instr.Salaries, NonInstr.Salaries, Benefits
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    key    = paste0("SF_", str_remove(col, ":.*$")),
    prefix = str_extract(code, "^F\\d+"),
    suffix = str_extract(code, "(?<=_)\\d+$"),
    line   = str_match(title, "\\(Line (\\d+),")[, 2],
    group  = case_when(
      prefix == "F2250" ~ "School Age",
      prefix == "F2251" ~ "Early Intervention",
      prefix == "F2252" ~ "Preschool",
      prefix == "F2253" ~ "Summer",
      TRUE              ~ "Other"
    ),
    item_name = case_when(
      suffix == "0"   ~ "Total",
      suffix == "15"  ~ "Instructional Salaries",
      suffix == "16"  ~ "Non-Instructional",
      suffix == "2"   ~ "Equipment",
      suffix == "4"   ~ "Contractual & Other",
      suffix == "45"  ~ "Materials & Supplies",
      suffix == "471" ~ "Tuition To Public Schools",
      suffix == "472" ~ "Tuition To Other",
      suffix == "473" ~ "Tuition To Charter Schools",
      suffix == "48"  ~ "Textbooks",
      suffix == "49"  ~ "BOCES Services",
      suffix == "8"   ~ "Employee Benefits",
      suffix == "95"  ~ "Xfer to Special Aid Fund",
      TRUE            ~ "Other"    ),
    label = paste0("SPED - ", item_name, " - ", group, " (", code, ")")
  ) %>%
  arrange(match(suffix, item_order), match(group, group_order), line)

stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(sf_meta$label), !anyDuplicated(sf_meta$key))

######## General Funds & Legal Metadata (sped_meta)
sped_meta <- spec_all %>%
  filter(
    (str_starts(code, "A1420_") |   # Keep Legal
       str_starts(code, "A2250_") |  # Keep SPED
       str_starts(code, "A2820_") |  # keep psychological
       str_starts(code, "A2825_") |  # keep social worker
       str_starts(code, "A2830_")    # keep special schools
     ), 
    !str_detect(code, "_0$"),        # Exclude A2250_0 (totals)
    !str_detect(code, "_(15|16|8)$") # Exclude salaries and employee benefits
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    prefix    = str_extract(code, "^A\\d+"),
    suffix    = str_extract(code, "(?<=_)\\d+$"),
    key       = paste0("SPED_", str_remove(col, ":.*$")),
    item_base = case_when(
      suffix == "0"   ~ "Total",
      suffix == "15"  ~ "Instructional Salaries",
      suffix == "16"  ~ "Non-Instructional",
      suffix == "2"   ~ "Equipment",
      suffix == "4"   ~ "Contractual & Other",
      suffix == "45"  ~ "Materials & Supplies",
      suffix == "471" ~ "Tuition To Public Schools",
      suffix == "472" ~ "Tuition To Other",
      suffix == "473" ~ "Tuition To Charter Schools",
      suffix == "48"  ~ "Textbooks",
      suffix == "49"  ~ "BOCES Services",
      suffix == "8"   ~ "Employee Benefits",
      suffix == "95"  ~ "Xfer to Special Aid Fund",
      TRUE            ~ "Other"
    ),
    program_label = case_when(
      prefix == "A1420" ~ "Legal",
      prefix == "A2820" ~ "Psychological",
      prefix == "A2825" ~ "Social Work",
      prefix == "A2830" ~ "Special Schools",
      TRUE              ~ ""
    ),
    item_name = if_else(program_label != "", paste0(program_label, " - ", item_base), paste0("SPED - ", item_base)),
    label     = paste0(item_name, " (", code, ")")
  ) %>%
  arrange(prefix, match(suffix, item_order))

stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(sped_meta$label), !anyDuplicated(sped_meta$key))

######## Clean Spending Data
# Extract base demographic/identifier columns
spending_clean <- spending_raw %>%
  filter(!is.na(NAME)) %>%
  transmute(
    ENTITY_CD   = BEDSCODE,
    ENTITY_NAME = NAME,
    COUNTY_DESC = COUNTY_DESC,
    YEAR        = as.numeric(YEAR)
  )

# Dynamically extract and clean SPED & Legal values based on sped_meta
sped_values <- spending_raw %>%
  filter(!is.na(NAME)) %>%
  select(all_of(sped_meta$col)) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ pmax(replace_na(as.numeric(.x), 0), 0)))
names(sped_values) <- sped_meta$key

# Dynamically extract SPED Total (A2250_0) from spec_all
total_col <- spec_all %>% filter(code == "A2250_0") %>% pull(col)
if (length(total_col) > 0) {
  sped_values$SPED_Total <- pmax(replace_na(as.numeric(spending_raw %>% filter(!is.na(NAME)) %>% pull(all_of(total_col[1]))), 0), 0)
}

# Dynamically extract Special Aid Fund values based on sf_meta
sf_values <- spending_raw %>%
  filter(!is.na(NAME)) %>%
  select(all_of(sf_meta$col)) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ pmax(replace_na(as.numeric(.x), 0), 0)))
names(sf_values) <- sf_meta$key

# Merge all cleaned columns
spending_clean <- bind_cols(spending_clean, sped_values, sf_values)

# Format BEDS Code to prevent scientific notation in JSON serialization
spending_clean$ENTITY_CD <- format(spending_clean$ENTITY_CD, scientific = FALSE)

# Pass data to Observable JS
ojs_define(
  df_to_js       = spending_clean,
  sped_fields_js = sped_meta %>% select(key, label, item_name),
  sf_fields_js   = sf_meta %>% select(key, label, item_name)
)

```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
```
```{ojs}
// Guard function - toolbar architecture (county -> district submit/reset)
function guard(fn, options = {}, countyView) {
  const {
    submitLabel = "Submit",
    resetLabel = "Reset",
    required = false,
    resubmit = true,
    width = "100%",
    justify = "start"
  } = options;

  const onSubmit = () => {
    value = input.value;
    submit.disabled = !resubmit || invalid;
    reset.disabled = true;
    wrapper.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true }));
  };
  const onReset = () => {
    input.value = value;
    submit.disabled = !resubmit || invalid;
    reset.disabled = true;
  };
  const onInnerInputCapture = () => {
    invalid = true;
    submit.disabled = true;
  };
  const onInnerInput = e => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    submit.disabled = false;
    reset.disabled = false;
  };
  const submit = htl.html`<button ${ { disabled: !resubmit && !required, onclick: onSubmit } } class="btn btn-primary btn-sm">${submitLabel}</button>`;
  const reset = htl.html`<button ${ { disabled: true, onclick: onReset } } class="btn btn-secondary btn-sm">${resetLabel}</button>`;
  const footer = htl.html`
    <div>
      <hr style="padding:0;margin:10px 0">
      <div style="display:flex;gap:1ch;justify-style: ${justify} ">
        ${submit}
      </div>
    </div>
  `;
  const template = inputs => {
    const row = document.createElement("div");
    row.className = "input-toolbar";
    row.append(countyView);
    (Array.isArray(inputs) ? inputs : Object.values(inputs))
      .forEach(input => row.append(input));
    const container = document.createElement("div");
    container.style.cssText = "width:100%;max-width:100%;min-width:0;box-sizing:border-box";
    container.append(row, footer);
    return container;
  };
  const input = fn({ submit, reset, footer, template, onSubmit, onReset });
  let invalid = !!input.querySelector(":invalid");
  submit.disabled = !resubmit || invalid;
  input.addEventListener("input", onInnerInputCapture, { capture: true });
  input.addEventListener("input", onInnerInput);
  let value = required ? undefined : input.value;
  const wrapper = htl.html`<div style="width: ${width} ">${input}`;
  wrapper.addEventListener("submit", onSubmit);
  return Object.defineProperty(wrapper, "value", {
    get: () => value,
    set: v => { input.value = v }
  });
}
```

```{ojs}
// Field list for the pie chart (label shown to user : underlying column)
// SPED fields (built in the R chunk from the CSV's Account Code row)
spedFields = transpose(sped_fields_js);

function toChartData(row, fields) {
  if (!row) return [];
  return fields
    .map(f => ({ label: f.label, value: +row[f.key] || 0 }))
    .filter(d => d.value > 0);
}

spedChartData = toChartData(selectedRow, spedFields);

// Special Funds fields (built in the R chunk from the CSV's Account Code row)
sfFields = transpose(sf_fields_js);
sfChartData = toChartData(selectedRow, sfFields);
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// Color scale for the General Funds

spendingColor = {
  // Shared color palette across all charts
  const EquipMaterialShades = d3.quantize(t => d3.interpolateYlOrBr(0.1 + t * 0.2), 3);
  const SPEDContracts  = d3.quantize(t => d3.interpolateGreens(.5), 1); 
  const legalShades  = d3.quantize(t => d3.interpolateReds(0.5 + t * 0.7), 3); 
  
  // Shades of Purple for Psychological, Social Work, and Special Schools (A2820_, A2825_, A2830_)
  const psychShades   = d3.quantize(t => d3.interpolatePurples(0.25 + t * 0.25), 3); // Lighter Purples
  const socialShades  = d3.quantize(t => d3.interpolatePurples(0.55 + t * 0.25), 3); // Mid Purples
  const specSchShades = d3.quantize(t => d3.interpolatePurples(0.82 + t * 0.15), 3); // Dark Purples

  // Shared shades of blue across all 3 plots for tuition and BOCES services
  const tuitionBlue1 = d3.interpolateBlues(0.30); // Tuition To Public Schools
  const tuitionBlue2 = d3.interpolateBlues(0.50); // Tuition To Other
  const tuitionBlue3 = d3.interpolateBlues(0.60); // Tuition To Charter Schools
  const tuitionBlue4 = d3.interpolateBlues(0.80); // BOCES Services (Lighter Blue)

  const colorMap = new Map([
    ["Legal - Contractual & Other", legalShades[0]],
    ["Legal - Materials & Supplies", legalShades[1]],
    ["Legal - BOCES Services", legalShades[2]],

    ["Psychological - Contractual & Other", psychShades[0]],
    ["Psychological - Materials & Supplies", psychShades[1]],
    ["Psychological - BOCES Services", psychShades[2]],

    ["Social Work - Contractual & Other", socialShades[0]],
    ["Social Work - Materials & Supplies", socialShades[1]],
    ["Social Work - BOCES Services", socialShades[2]],

    ["Special Schools - Contractual & Other", specSchShades[0]],
    ["Special Schools - Materials & Supplies", specSchShades[1]],
    ["Special Schools - BOCES Services", specSchShades[2]],

    ["SPED - Equipment", EquipMaterialShades[0]],
    ["SPED - Materials & Supplies", EquipMaterialShades[1]],
    ["SPED - Textbooks", EquipMaterialShades[2]],

    ["SPED - Contractual & Other", SPEDContracts[0]],

    ["SPED - Tuition To Public Schools", tuitionBlue1],
    ["SPED - Tuition To Other", tuitionBlue2],
    ["SPED - Tuition To Charter Schools", tuitionBlue3],
    ["SPED - BOCES Services", tuitionBlue4]
  ]);

  return d3.scaleOrdinal()
    .domain(spedFields.map(f => f.label))
    .range(spedFields.map(f => {
      // Normalize single vs double space if present
      const normName = f.item_name.replace(/^SPED\s+-\s+/, "SPED - ");
      if (colorMap.has(normName)) return colorMap.get(normName);
      if (colorMap.has(f.item_name)) return colorMap.get(f.item_name);
      if (f.item_name.startsWith("Psychological")) return d3.interpolatePurples(0.35);
      if (f.item_name.startsWith("Social Work")) return d3.interpolatePurples(0.65);
      if (f.item_name.startsWith("Special Schools")) return d3.interpolatePurples(0.85);
      return "#999";
    }));
}
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// Color scale for the Special Funds

sfColor = {
  // Groups with a single static color (no gradient) go here.
  const staticColors = {
    "Tuition To Public Schools":        d3.interpolateBlues(0.30),
    "Tuition To Other":                 d3.interpolateBlues(0.50),
    "Tuition To Charter Schools":       d3.interpolateBlues(0.60),
    "BOCES Services":                  d3.interpolateBlues(0.80),
    "Legal - Contractual & Other":     d3.interpolateReds(.2),
    "Legal - Materials & Supplies":    d3.interpolateReds(.3),
    "Legal - BOCES Services":          d3.interpolateReds(.35),
    "Contractual & Other":             d3.interpolateGreens(0.5)                     
  };
  // Groups shaded across a range of a d3 interpolator go here.
  const interps = {
    "Equipment":            d3.interpolateYlOrBr,
    "Materials & Supplies": d3.interpolateYlOrBr,
    "Textbooks":            d3.interpolateYlOrBr
  };
  // Per-color lightness band [min, max]; anything not listed uses the default.
  const defaultRange = [0.4, 0.9];
  const ranges = {
    "Equipment":            [0.1, 0.35],
    "Materials & Supplies": [0.1, 0.35],
    "Textbooks":            [0.1, 0.35]
  };
  const groups = d3.group(sfFields, f => f.item_name);
  const colorOf = new Map();
  for (const [g, members] of groups) {
    if (staticColors[g]) {
      members.forEach(f => colorOf.set(f.label, staticColors[g]));
      continue;
    }
    const interp = interps[g] || d3.interpolateGreys;
    const [lo, hi] = ranges[g] || defaultRange;
    members.forEach((f, i) => {
      const t = members.length === 1 ? 0.7 : i / (members.length - 1);
      colorOf.set(f.label, interp(lo + (hi - lo) * t));
    });
  }
  return d3.scaleOrdinal()
    .domain(sfFields.map(f => f.label))
    .range(sfFields.map(f => colorOf.get(f.label)));
}
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false

// Colors for Total chart
itemColor = {
  const byItem = new Map();
  for (const f of sfFields) {
    const combinedLabel = "SPED - " + f.item_name;
    byItem.set(combinedLabel, sfColor(f.label));
  }
  for (const f of spedFields) {
    if (f.item_name.startsWith("Legal")) {
      byItem.set("Legal", d3.interpolateReds(0.5));
    } else if (f.item_name.startsWith("Psychological")) {
      byItem.set("Psychological", d3.interpolatePurples(0.35));
    } else if (f.item_name.startsWith("Social Work")) {
      byItem.set("Social Work", d3.interpolatePurples(0.65));
    } else if (f.item_name.startsWith("Special Schools")) {
      byItem.set("Special Schools", d3.interpolatePurples(0.88));
    } else {
      const normName = f.item_name.replace(/^SPED\s+-\s+/, "SPED - ");
      if (!byItem.has(normName)) {
        byItem.set(normName, spendingColor(f.label));
      }
    }
  }
  return d3.scaleOrdinal()
    .domain([...byItem.keys()])
    .range([...byItem.values()]);
}
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// Combined chart data: sum the General Fund (spedFields) and Special Aid
// Fund (sfFields) values together by item type
combinedChartData = {
  const totals = new Map();
  function addFields(fields) {
    for (const f of fields) {
      const v = +selectedRow?.[f.key] || 0;
      let labelName = f.item_name;
      if (f.item_name.startsWith("Legal")) {
        labelName = "Legal";
      } else if (f.item_name.startsWith("Psychological")) {
        labelName = "Psychological";
      } else if (f.item_name.startsWith("Social Work")) {
        labelName = "Social Work";
      } else if (f.item_name.startsWith("Special Schools")) {
        labelName = "Special Schools";
      } else {
        const cleanName = f.item_name.replace(/^SPED\s+-\s+/, "");
        labelName = "SPED - " + cleanName;
      }
      
      totals.set(labelName, (totals.get(labelName) || 0) + v);
    }
  }
  if (selectedRow) {
    addFields(spedFields);
    addFields(sfFields);
  }
  return Array.from(totals, ([label, value]) => ({ label, value }))
    .filter(d => d.value > 0);
}
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// Reusable pie chart (d3), with a % label on larger slices and a legend.
function pieChart(data, { title = "", color = spendingColor, maxHeight = 350 } = {}) {
  const drawWidth = 460, drawHeight = 440;
  const maxWidth = maxHeight * (drawWidth / drawHeight);

  if (!data || data.length === 0) {
    return html`<div style="text-align:center;color:#888;padding:60px 20px;">
      <strong>${title}</strong><br>No spending reported for this district.
    </div>`;
  }

  const total = d3.sum(data, d => d.value);
  const radius = Math.min(drawWidth, drawHeight) / 2 - 20;

  const arcs = d3.pie().value(d => d.value).sort(null)(data);
  const arcGen = d3.arc().innerRadius(radius * 0.35).outerRadius(radius);

  const svg = d3.create("svg")
    .attr("viewBox", [-drawWidth / 2, -drawHeight / 2, drawWidth, drawHeight])
    .style("width", "100%")
    .style("height", "auto")
    .style("max-width", `${maxWidth}px`)
    .style("display", "block")
    .style("margin", "0 auto")
    .style("font", "12px sans-serif");

  svg.append("g")
    .selectAll("path")
    .data(arcs)
    .join("path")
      .attr("d", arcGen)
      .attr("fill", d => color(d.data.label))
      .attr("stroke", "white")
      .attr("stroke-width", 1)
    .append("title")
      .text(d => `${d.data.label}\n$${Math.round(d.data.value).toLocaleString()} (${((d.data.value / total) * 100).toFixed(1)}%)`);

  svg.append("g")
    .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
    .selectAll("text")
    .data(arcs)
    .join("text")
      .attr("transform", d => `translate(${arcGen.centroid(d)})`)
      .style("font-size", "10px")
      .style("font-weight", "600")
      .style("fill", "#fff")
      .text(d => (d.data.value / total) > 0.04 ? `${Math.round((d.data.value / total) * 100)}%` : "");

  svg.append("text")
      .attr("x", 0)
      .attr("y", -drawHeight / 2 + 16)
      .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
      .style("font-size", "15px")
      .style("font-weight", "bold")
      .text(title);

const legend = html`<div style="font-size:11px;margin:6px auto 0;width:fit-content;max-width:100%;">
  ${data.map(d => html`<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-start;gap:6px;margin:2px 0;">
    <span style="width:10px;height:10px;background:${color(d.label)};display:inline-block;border-radius:2px;flex:none;"></span>
    <span>${d.label}: <strong>$${Math.round(d.value).toLocaleString()}</strong></span>
  </div>`)}
</div>`;

return html`<div style="text-align:left;width:100%;">${svg.node()}${legend}</div>`;
}
```
